movie.title: Above & Below
movie.overview: A group of friends set off for an unforgettable vacation. What begins as an adventure of partying and diving quickly turns into a nightmare when they are attacked by criminals in open waters.

reviews.author: Sierbahnn
reviews.content: Antonio steals every scene he is in. Other than that this is a pretty decent little movie with sharks and badguys and people in the water. The cast does a good job, suspense is there, the plot and story works out, and apart from a massive leap of faith into complete disbelief in the end (well, two, if you count the flare) it stays relatively close to at least the pasture where reality spends most of its time.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A group of friends' dream diving vacation turns into a terrifying fight for survival when brutal criminals attack them in open waters.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Looking for the ultimate getaway, a group of close friends sets off on an unforgettable vacation filled with partying and ocean diving. Their thrilling adventure takes a dark turn when they are ambushed by ruthless criminals in the middle of open waters. Isolated from help and facing desperate odds, the group must fight back to survive the relentless attack. What began as a dream holiday swiftly devolves into a gripping nightmare of ocean-bound suspense.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Seeking excitement and relaxation, a tight-knit group of friends embarks on a high-energy vacation centered around tropical partying and deep-sea diving. The trip starts off as a dream come true as they enjoy the vibrant nightlife and explore stunning underwater depths. However, their idyllic escape is shattered when they encounter hostile criminals operating in open waters. Suddenly targeted in an unprovoked and violent attack, the friends find themselves stranded far from the safety of the shore. With no immediate hope of rescue, tension and fear quickly test the bonds of their friendship. They must rely on their instincts and diving gear to evade their armed pursuers both above and below the surface. As the criminals close in, the group is forced to make perilous decisions to protect one another. The fight for survival escalates into a desperate battle against both human cruelty and the unforgiving ocean. Ultimately, they must find a way to outsmart their attackers before time runs out in this high-stakes oceanic thriller.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Above & Below is an edge-of-your-seat thriller that follows a group of friends seeking the ultimate vacation getaway. After filling their days with sun-soaked partying and adventurous ocean diving, their dream trip devolves into a terrifying ordeal when they come across dangerous criminals operating far offshore. Cut off from assistance and surrounded by the vast expanse of the open sea, the friends must use their wits, underwater skills, and raw survival instincts to stay alive amidst constant danger.

story_structure.climax: The conflict reaches a breaking point in a high-stakes, desperate showdown against their aggressors, where every choice means the difference between life and death.
story_structure.conflict: While out at sea, the group encounters hostile criminals, suddenly thrusting their peaceful vacation into a fight for survival.
story_structure.resolution: The immediate threat is resolved, leaving the remaining survivors to deal with the physical and psychological aftermath of the ordeal as help arrives.
story_structure.introduction: A group of close friends embarks on a tropical getaway, diving into open-water adventures and celebrating their time together.
story_structure.risingAction: Stranded and targeted in open waters, tension mounts as the friends attempt to outmaneuver their attackers, evade environmental hazards, and protect one another.
